description:
Export visual state transition trajectories (formats: json, llava, qwen2_vl, joint). Formats: "json" (raw state steps), "llava" / "qwen2_vl" (VLM fine-tuning datasets), "joint" (interleaved workflow events correlated by session/trace ID for state-memory-mcp). Use export_trajectories instead of create_evidence_pack when exporting training data or cross-server event logs rather than cryptographic compliance packs.

Returns exported trajectory array, formatted VLM training records, or joint event stream.

limit.description: Maximum number of states to export (default: 50)

trace_id.description: Optional trace ID / session ID filter (used with joint format)

name: export_trajectories
